name: Saving Grace
source:
For years you have wandered, giving glory to God by seeing things closely. You follow the winds to the dusted-over remains of some lost time and wonder why He put these things here.

[From [url=https://howling-angel-games.itch.io/saving-grace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多年来你一直在徘徊，通过仔细观察事物来荣耀上帝。你顺着风来到了一段逝去时光的尘土飞扬的遗迹，想知道他为什么把这些东西放在这里。

[来自[url=https://howling-angel-games.itch.io/saving-grace]Itch.io[/url]]
